mechanism: Colchicine-induced GI toxicity (diarrhea, malabsorption) can lead to potassium depletion, while potassium supplementation may worsen colchicine-induced GI irritation and ulceration risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; assess need for potassium supplementation based on clinical context and renal function; separate administration timing if possible and counsel on GI symptoms.
